mapper.select: SELECT num, atc_id AS atcId, id, lst_place AS lstPlace, lst_prdt_nm AS lstPrdtNm, lst_sbjt AS lstSbjt, lst_ymd AS lstYmd, prdt_cl_nm AS prdtClNm, created_at, updated_at, done, is_deleted FROM lost_police WHERE atc_id = #{atcId}
